title: The first departures: Herschel Evans, Walter Page and the trombones
summary: They recall Herschel going first and Buddy Tate replacing him, and trombone changes through 1939.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Freddie, I think maybe what we ought to do is go back to the band that we were talking about, and start to talk about where the changes first came, you know? How it began to get away from that. What was the first major change? Was it the war coming? And, was it Lester being drafted, or what -- who were the first guys to have to get out of the band one way or another? Can you remember?
Yeah. Herschel was about the first one --
Well, of course, that was nice to get
Buddy did come right in and replace him, didn't he?
And, he fitted in, didn't he?
Yeah. And, he and Lester were good friends?
I'm trying to think who else got out of there before the war.
When did Earl Warren come in?
Well, Earl Warren came in, you know, when Caughey Roberts went.
So he came in early, didn't he?
And, he stayed with the band for a long time?
Yeah. He stayed. Yeah. And, let's see -- who got
When did Page go? When did Walter Page go?
Did he get sick -- then leave the band?
I never did realize -- did he?
Was he nearly twenty years with the band?
Why? Was he out for awhile because he was sick?
Yeah. Then he was with different bands.
Yeah. Well, the major changes seem to be in the trombones at first when you get see, Benny Morton Dicky Wells, Eddie Durham --
Yeah. Well, they were -- well, Eddie Durham came in, and then, -- see then --
Yeah. I remember. And then Hunt -- George Hunt left. What happened to George Hunt?
So, it was Dicky and who, Stan?
Dicky and Dan Minor are still there in '38. Then Benny Morton, Dicky, and then Harry Edison takes Bobby Moore's place.
Then, in '39 you get four trumpets with Shad Collins.
So, it's still really staying the same band. What we're really trying to think is who --
